name: n2_gqe_angles
description: GQE on DMET N2 with amplitude-FREE rotation angles. Default pool: every excitation has ONE fixed angle = 2 x CCSD amplitude, so GQE can choose gates but not how far they rotate; at stretch the CCSD amplitudes are unreliable and every seed plateaus (2.1 A: 40.4598 kcal/mol in 8/8 runs). Here every excitation is offered at angles +-0.1, +-0.4, +-1.0 (CCSD only selects which excitations exist), alone and with a 0.01 amplitude threshold to keep the vocabulary small. 80 gates, 120 epochs, seeds 4-6 (determinant dumps on). Compare with n2_gqe_ens (same seeds, CCSD angles). --out $B/n2_curve.
